title: Bound new independent BIT owners and replay a 681-owner control
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The forward and adjoint tight banks use 537 and 524 scalar stock observations for the same numbers of independent old demands. Keeping every demand fixes the capacity obstruction for a new independent owner. The narrower new-source/one-last-receipt search tested 14,452 positive productive legs and 600,832 cheaper sender cases. A real 681-owner word with one added grade-eight receipt has exactly equal added paid and productive tariffs.

## Task and overlap

Refined #7852 follow-up on main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, toolkit `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`, and native comparator #7830 at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. Compare the projected old-owner work in #7984 at `e1dd7de81018f3eda71dad83ab72bab6e8faeb9e` and #7985 at `251e15df3e0c058a843e7cb13f5882179a4e3afc`. This scope retains every original owner.

## Validation

A fresh Python 3.12 extraction passed the included 31-file checks, both literal operators, owner-411 purity, 36/48 prices and the entire exact enumeration. The corrected sender detector includes a positive synthetic control. See the extracted README’s full commands.

## Open next questions

Try an independently varied old source component, an earlier paid addition or a genuinely changed productive interface. The preserved κ and finite premises remain separate.
